title: consolidate-sdks-streaming-decoders-and-retry-policy-ergonomics
author: Anya Patel
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs implemented similar streaming parsing and retry logic in slightly different ways which caused subtle behavioral differences (auth refresh timing, backoff jitter, and chunk decoding) and created developer ergonomics gaps. This PR unifies the surface and implements backward-compatible ergonomic helpers. Changes include: 1) Introduce a small, consistent RetryPolicy interface across Python/TS/Go with a default ExponentialJitter implementation; 2) Extract a streaming decoder abstraction (ChunkDecoder) used by all SDKs so chunk framing, partial utf-8 boundaries, and streaming JSON pieces behave identically; 3) Add ergonomics: Python .stream_tokens() async iterator, TS .streamToAsyncIterable(), and Go StreamText(ctx) helper returning a channel and cancel func; 4) Auth: centralize token refresh hook so SDKs avoid double-refresh races and emit consistent metrics/tags; 5) Tests + migration notes and version bumps (python 0.14.0, ts 0.21.1, go 0.8.0). Backwards compatibility: default behaviors preserve previous timeouts and retry counts; new helpers are additive. See linked issues and changelog entries for migration steps.
